title: We did the Bike Tour...
text:
We did the Bike Tour Barcelona in November, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. Our guide, Jordi, was incredibly nice and friendly — he shared so much interesting information about Barcelona throughout the ride, and made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable.

The best part of the tour was definitely the incredible views from the trail. Seeing Barcelona from above while riding through such beautiful scenery was unforgettable. The overall vibe of the tour was very relaxed, and Jordi made sure to go at a pace that felt comfortable for everyone, which we really appreciated.

I
author: Paul_R

title: Beautiful day out in the mountains of Barcelona
text:
What a fun day out in the mountains in Barcelona! Jordi is an incredibly experienced, attentive and fun instructor and guide. He adapted the tour to our level (we have experience cycling, but never tried mountain biking) and challenged us to try more difficult mountain biking trails as that's what we were looking for! We will definitely keep signing up for lessons on learning more mountain biking technical skills and we are so grateful to have found Jordi!

The views were stunning and the company even better!
author: Alice_W

title: The unseen side of Barcelona
text:
This tour offers views of Barcelona like no other. The hour and a half long mountain bike ride off the broken tracks on the mountain was one hell of an experience. The ride is a little addictive as it leaves you wishing you could come back the next day as well. 
Jordi is the coolest and he was the perfect tour guide. A guy who does this because he truly enjoys the sport and is passionate about biking. Definitely meeting up again when I'm back in Barcelona.
